tasks.commitBody:
The agenda day header was 10px muted ink — identical treatment to
the row duration, the least significant text on the rows it heads,
and to the gap marker and Recent-row date. A heading quieter than
its own content cannot do a heading's job; Joosep read it exactly
so ('kuupäev on justkui sektsiooni pealkiri ja see võiks olla
suurem').

The header now reads as a section title: text-base, full-strength
ink, font-semibold, keeping the app's small-caps idiom
(tracking-wide uppercase) so it stays a marker rather than a
sentence. Vertical rhythm is adjusted for the larger type so day
sections read as separated blocks. Today's bg-highlight still works.

Done-when 4 asked engineering to pick the TÄNA/HOMME differentiator
and say which. It is an OUTLINED PILL — `rounded-full border
border-ink px-2` — and deliberately not a size or weight step. Those
spans used to differentiate by `font-semibold text-ink` against a
lighter, non-semibold date; now that the header line carries both,
repeating them on the span is an inherited no-op that looks like a
differentiator without being one. A size step is the other obvious
reach and is wrong here: the DATE is the section title this issue is
enlarging, and the relative marker only qualifies WHICH section, so
out-sizing the date would re-invert the very hierarchy #250 came to
fix. The pill differentiates by SHAPE, so it holds at the line's own
size, weight and ink, and it reuses the app's established
rounded-full small-caps marker idiom rather than reading as a louder
heading. Outline and not fill because on today's row the marker sits
inside the bg-highlight band, where a bg-ink-5 fill would carry only
~1.4:1 against that yellow.

The spec names that mechanism token by token instead of accepting
'at least one distinct token', and pins the two negatives — no
font-size utility on the marker, no re-declared font-semibold or
text-ink — so the differentiator cannot decay back into an
incidental leftover.

Deliberately fenced: the gap marker and the Recent-row date keep
their current quiet treatment — they are not section titles, and
restyling every small-caps line is the over-reach this issue
refused. Grouping, ordering, formatters (the DST-guarded block is
#251's territory) and all testids are untouched.

Live gate (Joosep): open the agenda — day sections now separate at
a glance; TÄNA/HOMME still read as markers, today is still
highlighted.
